cold exposure and sleep are related to changes in the sleep electroencephalograph (EEG), sleep architecture, and the EEG during wakefulness.

(1) Cold exposure increases the amount of slow-wave sleep and rapid eye movement sleep in rats; (2) the electroencephelogram during sleep in cold-exposed rats has a higher amplitude and a slower frequency; and (3) cold exposure decreases the amount of slow wave activity in the electroencephalogram.

the effects of cold exposure on sleep and EEG.
the effects of cold exposure on sleep architecture and on the electroencephalam.
the effects of cold exposure and sleep deprivation on sleep and the electroence phalogram in rats.

cold exposure does not affect the electroencephahlogram or sleep architecture of the rat.
cold exposure in rats is associated with increased slow wave sleep and decreased rapid eye movement (REM) sleep.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we found that sleep architecture and the EEG are affected by acute cold exposure.
the cold exposure is a stressor for the rat, and that this stressor has a profound effect on the electroencephahalogram (EEG), and the sleep architecture of the rat.
cold exposure in the rat has a biphasic effect on sleep.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cold exposure is a powerful sleep inducer, but it does not affect the quality of sleep, and it does not affect REM sleep.
